text:
Carmen Rivera: Heads up — CloudPartner wants Redwood listed in AWS/GCP/Azure catalogs. Goal: initial submission by end of week. We need artifacts (AMI/container), SKU mapping, pricing bundles, legal (EULA/DPA), and support/contact info. Who can own which piece?
Alex Chen: I can take legal. Need sample EULA they expect + DPA template. Also confirm if data residency/processing terms differ per marketplace.
Jeff Patel: I can own SKU/pricing packaging. Proposal: two SKUs (standard, enterprise) + meterable compute add-on. Need to confirm trial entitlements and free-tier durations.
Sam Nguyen: I'll handle the artifact builds. Clarify: AWS wants AMI + CloudFormation, GCP wants image + deployment manager, Azure wants managed image + ARM template. Also need checksums and signed image manifest.
Toni Brooks: Sales asks for a 14-day trial for GCP, 30-day promo for AWS launch. Also want BYOL option for enterprise customers. We should reflect that in the offer metadata.
Alex Chen: For legal: include explicit marketplace indemnity limits, export control clause, and data processing addendum. If CloudPartner provides a vendor EULA, compare vs our standard. I need any custom terms by Wed.
marketplace-bot: task created -> MK-788: "Partner listing artifacts & legal checklist" assigned to @Carmen @Alex @Jeff @Sam. (details: https://tracker.internal/MK-788)
Carmen Rivera: OK; here's a minimal artifact checklist to start sharing with engineering and product:
- signed image (AMI/OCI) + checksum
- deployment templates (CFN/ARM/DM)
- offer metadata JSON (display name, description, categories, pricing tiers)
- legal bundle (EULA, DPA, SOC/ISO attestation links)
- support contact (email + SLOs)

Sam Nguyen: dropping a sample manifest snippet below for packaging team to mirror:
```
{
  "name": "redwood-inference",
  "version": "1.0.0",
  "platform": "aws",
  "images": [
    {"region": "us-east-1", "ami": "ami-0abc1234", "sha256": "d4c3..."}
  ],
  "templates": ["cloudformation/offer-stack.yaml"]
}
```
Jeff Patel: For pricing matrix, I'll draft CSV with SKU ids. Example SKUs: `RWF-STD-1`, `RWF-ENT-1`, `RWF-COMPUTE-ADDON`. Will share by tomorrow morning.
Toni Brooks: Also need marketing blurb (50-100 words) and two screenshots for the listing page. Can design ops get this?
Carmen Rivera: @DesignOps please chime in — can we get screenshots + 1p blurb by Thu? :pray:
Alex Chen: quick note — if we include telemetry or usage data collection, ensure the consent language is explicit in the listing and DPA.
Sam Nguyen: deployment checklist for eng: kernel args, instance profile permissions, and user-data script. I'll attach runbook once we finalize AMI build.
Jeff Patel: tagging the rollout plan: staging listing -> private preview -> public GA. We should test purchases in vendor sandbox accounts per cloud.
Carmen Rivera: Thanks all. Action items: Alex legal (EULA/DPA diff) due Wed; Jeff pricing + SKUs due tomorrow AM; Sam images + manifest due Thu AM; Toni marketing assets due Thu EOD. I'll consolidate and submit to CloudPartner on Fri. :v:
Toni Brooks: ack :thumbsup:
marketplace-bot: reminder scheduled for 24h before submission deadline (Fri 09:00 UTC).
